HOME SCIENCE MARCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 50 °C

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Convenience Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Convenience Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Convenience Foods.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Convenience Foods.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Convenience Foods.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting 2.5 Maternal Health Care 2.6 Child Health Care 2.7 Care.

5. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Meals for Special Occasions? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Meals for Special Occasions.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Meals for Special Occasions.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Meals for Special Occasions.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Meals for Special Occasions.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care of the Home: Exterior Environment 2.2 Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treat.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Special Treatment in Laundry Work? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Special Treatment in Laundry Work.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Special Treatment in Laundry Work.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Consumer Protection? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Consumer Protection.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Consumer Protection.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Consumer Protection.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Consumer Protection.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Ventilation and Lighting? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Ventilation and Lighting.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Ventilation and Lighting.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Ventilation and Lighting.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Ventilation and Lighting.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pastry Making? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pastry Making.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pastry Making.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pastry Making.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pastry Making.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Care of the Home: Exterior Environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection 2.3 Special Treatment in Laundry Work 2.4 Ventilation and Li and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Special Treatment in Laundry Work and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
